title: 第1章 肝它个天荒地老第2章 第二位玩家
slug: 游戏入侵开局挖掌天瓶
content_zh:
“当！”
生锈的铁镐重重砸在坚硬的暗红色岩壁上。火星迸射。
苏寒双手虎口震得龟裂。他握着粗糙的木柄。手心里的三个水泡已经磨破，渗出的血水和黑色的矿灰混杂在一起，凝结成坚硬的血痂。
他没有停下。腰背拉成一张紧绷的弓，双臂肌肉隆起，再次抡起铁镐。
“当！”
一块拇指大小的赤铁矿石剥落下来，砸在滚烫的碎石堆里。
苏寒迅速弯腰，捡起这块带着余温的矿石，塞进腰间早已磨破边的粗布兜。
饥饿、疲惫，被岩石尖角划破皮肤时的火辣刺痛，百分之百真实。
他用手背抹去流进眼睛里的咸涩汗水，目光垂落，看向三十步外的一辆破旧独轮木车。
木车上躺着一具尸体。
尸体暴晒了整整三天。腹部肿胀成一个巨大的暗紫色水袋。成群的绿头苍蝇在空洞的眼眶里进进出出，发出密集的嗡嗡声。
三天前，那个人因为体力不支倒地，挨了监工一鞭子。那人疯了一般对着天空大喊“退出游戏”、“呼叫客服”、“放我出去”。
矿区玄衣卫的制式长刀直接挥下。
那个人的头颅滚落在暗红色的矿渣里。脖颈处喷涌出的鲜血溅了三尺高。
没有白光闪烁，没有尸体刷新，更没有复活点重生的奇迹。人死如灯灭，化作一具发臭的死肉。
在这个《荒域》世界死了，就是真的死了。现实世界里的肉身，只会同步脑死亡。
苏寒收回视线。他的呼吸平稳而悠长。
活着。不惜一切代价地活着。绝不出风头，绝不惹是生非，绝不把命运交到任何人的怜悯里。
他再次抡起铁镐，对准那块最坚硬的红岩。
“当！”

岩层碎裂。一丝常人根本无法察觉的冰凉气流，顺着铁镐的木柄，钻入苏寒的掌心。
气流化作春雨，迅速游走遍他的四肢百骸。酸痛胀裂的肌肉纤维，在清凉气流的滋润下，快速修补着细微的劳损。骨缝里的疲惫消散一空。
半透明的淡蓝色光幕，在苏寒的视网膜上弹开。
【叮！】
【恭喜，你已升级，获得1点自由属性点！】
苏寒的眼底跳动了一下。
他死死咬住后槽牙，将嘴角那一丝上扬的弧度生生按压下去。脸部肌肉重新松垮，恢复到底层矿工特有的呆滞与麻木。
这是他来到《荒域》第十五天，安身立命的最大本钱。
挖矿，等于获取经验值。经验值不仅能升级，更能化作气流，修复肉体的疲劳。
只要他不被饿死，不被人杀死，他就是一台可以无限续航的挖矿机器。
他在心中默念，唤出完整的属性面板。
【姓名：苏寒】
【职业：矿工】
【等级：3】
【自由属性点：1】
【力量：5】
【敏捷：5】
【精神：10】
【生命值：5050】
苏寒在脑海中冷静地分析数据。

普通成年男性的初始数据，力量和敏捷都在5点上下。精神力高达10点，全靠穿越者的灵魂特质叠加。
在这座人吃人的赤铁矿，力量决定了每天能挖出多少矿，决定了能不能换到足以果腹的黑面馒头。更决定了遇到危险时，能不能挥出致命的一击。
“加点。力量。”
指令在脑海中下达。
content_en:
"Dang!"
The rusty iron pickaxe hit the hard dark red rock wall hard. Sparks shot out.
Su Han's hands were cracked by the shock. He held the rough wooden handle. The three blisters on the palm of my hand have been broken, and the oozing blood is mixed with black mineral ash, condensing into a hard blood scab.
He didn't stop. The back was stretched into a tight bow, the muscles of both arms bulged, and the pickaxe was picked up again.
"Dang!"
A piece of hematite ore the size of a thumb fell off and hit the pile of hot rubble.
Su Han quickly bent down, picked up the warm ore, and stuffed it into the frayed coarse cloth pocket around his waist.
The hunger, exhaustion, and the burning sting when the sharp edges of the rock cut into the skin are 100% real.
He wiped away the salty sweat that flowed into his eyes with the back of his hand, lowered his eyes and looked at an old wheelbarrow thirty steps away.
There was a body lying on the wooden cart.
The body was exposed to the sun for three full days. The abdomen swells into a huge dark purple bag of water. Swarms of blowflies darted in and out of the empty eye sockets, making a dense buzzing sound.
Three days ago, that man fell to the ground due to exhaustion and was whipped by the supervisor. The man went crazy and shouted to the sky, "Quit the game," "Call customer service," and "Let me out."
The standard long sword of the Xuanyi Guard in the mining area was swung down directly.
The man's head fell into the dark red slag. The blood spurted out from his neck and splashed three feet high.
There is no white light flashing, no corpse refreshing, and no miracle of rebirth at the resurrection point. When a person dies, he is like a lamp extinguished and turned into a stinking corpse.
If you die in this "Desolate Realm" world, you are really dead. The physical body in the real world will only die simultaneously with the brain.
Su Han withdrew his gaze. His breathing was steady and long.
alive. Live at all costs. Never seek the limelight, never cause trouble, and never leave your fate to anyone's mercy.
He picked up the pickaxe again and aimed it at the hardest red rock.
"Dang!"
Rock formations crumble. A trace of cold air, which ordinary people could not detect, followed the wooden handle of the iron pickaxe and penetrated into Su Han's palm.
The air flow turned into spring rain and quickly traveled all over his limbs and bones. The sore and swollen muscle fibers were quickly repaired by the moistening of the cool air. The fatigue in the bones dissipated.
The translucent light blue light curtain bounced on Su Han's retina.
【bite! 】
[Congratulations, you have been upgraded and gained 1 free attribute point! 】
Su Han's eyes jumped.
He gritted his back molars and suppressed the upward curve at the corner of his mouth. The facial muscles became loose again, returning to the sluggishness and numbness unique to low-level miners.
This is the biggest asset he has to settle down on his fifteenth day in the "Desolate Realm".
Mining is equivalent to gaining experience points. Experience points can not only be upgraded, but can also be turned into airflow to repair physical fatigue.
As long as he doesn't starve to death or be killed, he is a mining machine with unlimited battery life.
He muttered silently in his mind and summoned the complete attribute panel.
[Name: Su Han]
[Occupation: Miner]
[Level: 3]
[Free attribute points: 1]
【Strength: 5】
[Agility: 5]
【Spirit: 10】
[Health value: 5050]
Su Han calmly analyzed the data in his mind.
The initial statistics of an average adult male are around 5 points in strength and agility. The mental power is as high as 10 points, which depends entirely on the superposition of the soul characteristics of the traveler.
In this hematite mine where people eat people, strength determines how much ore can be dug out every day, and whether it can be replaced with enough black-faced steamed buns to satisfy the hunger. It also determines whether you can deliver a fatal blow when in danger.
"Add more. Strength."
The order was given in his mind.
